title: Multistory lowest portion sizing.
officialText:
The size of the lowest connector and of the vertical vent leading to the lowest
interconnection of a multistory system shall be in accordance with Table 504.2(1) or 504.2(2) for available total height (H) up
to the lowest interconnection.
